checks.name: schema_columns_present
checks.details: Required: paper_id, title, summary, text_for_embedding, published, age_days. Missing columns break embedding, evaluation or freshness downstream.

checks.name: row_count_minimum
checks.details: A dataset smaller than top_k cannot return a full retrieval result set.

checks.name: paper_id_not_null
checks.details: paper_id is the join key between raw, clean, index and ground truth.

checks.name: paper_id_unique
checks.details: Duplicates inflate the corpus and let one paper occupy several top-k slots.

checks.name: title_not_empty
checks.details: The title drives exact lookup in the agent.

checks.name: text_for_embedding_not_empty
checks.details: An empty embedding text produces a document that can never be retrieved.

checks.name: summary_min_length
checks.details: Blank or truncated summaries are the corruption the agent notices first.

checks.name: freshness_age_days
checks.details: The source filter only requests recent papers, so any stale row is injected.
